question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Malign
solution: The correct answer is '**Besmirch**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Malign**' is '**Besmirch**'. • **Malign**: to say or write bad things about somebody/something publicly especially in a unfair manner. (दुर्भावनापूर्वक लेख से या मौखिक निंदा करके किसी को सार्वजनिक रूप से बदनाम करना) • *Example: You are **maligning** a respectable body of men.* • **Besmirch**: damage (someone's reputation). [क्षति (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा)] • *Example: He had **besmirched** the good name of his family. * **Correct Answer:__** *Besmirch.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Approve**: to be pleased about something; to like somebody/something. (किसी को पसंद करना या उससे संतुष्‍ट होना; स्‍वीकार्य समझना) • **Benefit**: an advantage or useful effect that something has. (लाभ, हित, फ़ायदा) • **Commend**: to say officially that somebody/something is very good. (अधिकृत रूप से प्रशंसा करना; सराहना करना) 42:T902, The correct answer is: **give notice.**
